thread.title_full: Natural Cure Labs (NCL) Celebrates Major Milestone: 200,000 Customers, 35 Million Capsules Sold, and 7,000 Verified Reviews

author: 24-7 Press
title: Natural Cure Labs (NCL) Celebrates Major Milestone: 200,000 Customers, 35 Million Capsules Sold, and 7,000 Verified Reviews
text:
ST. PETERSBURG, FL, December 03, 2025 /24-7PressRelease/ — Natural Cure Labs (NCL), a trusted leader in science-backed dietary supplements and a pioneer in monolaurin supplements, is proud to announce it has surpassed 200,000 customers worldwide, with over 35 million capsules sold and 7,000 verified customer reviews to date. This major milestone highlights the company’s longstanding commitment to clean-label quality, transparency, and customer trust, as well as its drive for continuous product innovation in the nutritional supplement industry.
For NCL (Natural Cure Labs), these figures are more than just numbers – they represent the loyalty of the customers who choose its products every day. With over 7,000 verified reviews across its supplement range, including its flagship monolaurin formulations, NCL continues to earn trust through quality, consistency, and transparency. These testimonials underscore the efficacy and reliability of its products, reflecting the brand’s positive impact and strong connection with health-conscious consumers.
“Reaching this milestone is not just about sales or statistics – it’s a testament to our customers’ trust and our team’s commitment to excellence,” said Damon Sununtnasuk, Founder & CEO of NCL. “Since day one, we’ve put our customers at the heart of everything we do. By focusing on quality and innovation above all, we’ve built a community that believes in our products. We are incredibly proud of this achievement and grateful to every customer who made it possible. This success inspires us to continue raising the bar to serve our customers even better in the years to come.”
Founded in 2015, NCL (Natural Cure Labs) has grown from a single monolaurin-based supplement into an international brand serving customers around the globe. Over the past decade, the company has expanded its portfolio of science-backed wellness products to include L-Lysine, Andrographis, Biofilm, and Level Off for glucose support, while maintaining a relentless focus on quality, transparency, and customer trust. The company now operates out of three manufacturing facilities in New York, New Jersey, and California and has products in over 100 warehouses nationwide. This commitment to USA-based excellence has earned NCL numerous industry accolades and a reputation as a leader in clean-label supplementation.
In 2025, NCL’s rapid growth earned national recognition. The company was named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies and honored with its ninth Stevie® Award from the American Business Awards, which recognized NCL’s product innovation and exceptional customer experience. To date, NCL (Natural Cure Labs) has won over 40 industry awards across its product line cementing its reputation as a leader in transparent, high-quality supplementation.
Looking ahead, NCL remains dedicated to its customer-first values and mission. The company plans to continue developing innovative health solutions and expanding access to its monolaurin and metabolic health supplements, all while upholding the rigorous quality standards that customers have come to trust.
About Natural Cure Labs
Natural Cure Labs (NCL) is a U.S.-based dietary supplement manufacturer focused on clean-label, science-backed formulas for immune support, metabolic health, and overall wellness. Best known for its pioneering monolaurin products, NCL offers a full line of supplements that are vegan, non-GMO, and gluten-free – all made in GMP-certified facilities in the United States and third-party tested in ISO 17025-accredited labs to ensure identity, purity, and potency. Since 2015, NCL’s products have reached hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide, with tens of millions of capsules sold to date. The company’s unwavering commitment to quality, transparency, and innovation has earned the trust of consumers and over 40 industry awards, making NCL a leader in high-quality wellness supplements. For more information, please visit https://www.naturalcurelabs.com
